changelog: Settings no longer triggers password-save prompts for tokens
Operational secrets in Settings (AI API key/token, Telegram bot token, SMTP password, SSO client secret and SNMPv3 keys) no longer render as browser password fi
The reveal-eye button is no longer added to the API key/token or other operational secrets marked as non-revealable. Real login, password-change and user-manage
